snippets.output: Neurological issues can be categorized into several types, including Central Nervous System (CNS) disorders, Peripheral Nervous System (PNS) disorders, neurodevelopmental disorders, and neurodegenerative disorders.
Central Nervous System (CNS) disorders affect the brain and spinal cord and can include conditions such as stroke, traumatic brain injury, and multiple sclerosis.

snippets.output: Peripheral Nervous System (PNS) disorders affect the nerves outside the brain and spinal cord and can include conditions such as peripheral neuropathy, carpal tunnel syndrome, and Guillain-Barré syndrome.
snippets.pattern_notes: PNS disorders: location plus enumerated example conditions.

snippets.output: Neurodevelopmental disorders affect the development of the nervous system and can include conditions such as autism spectrum disorder, attention deficit hyperactivity disorder (ADHD), and cerebral palsy.

snippets.output: Neurodegenerative disorders cause progressive damage to the nervous system and can include conditions such as Alzheimer's disease, Parkinson's disease, and amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS).
